name: TierMeetingBoard
tagline: Tier 1–3 SQDC daily management board with roll-up and escalations
description: SQDC letters per line, value stream and plant with automatic roll-up, KPI targets, actions, escalation between tiers and a stand-up timer – for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: SQDC(P) letter shapes or calendar grid
Status from KPI values vs targets or set by the team
Roll-up of lower tiers (worst status per day)
KPI latest value, sparkline, red/amber counts, green streak
Actions with owners, due dates, filters
Escalate up / return down between tiers
Stand-up timer highlighting the live letter
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and ARIA
